name: Reagents for Reclaimers Inc.
summary: In Desolace, Kreldig Ungor has the last items Leftwitch requested. They all come from demons: brains, wings, and blood.

sections.title: The Last of the List
sections.body: Kreldig Ungor warns you that the final set is grim and slower to gather than any before. Leftwitch wants ten of each of three kinds of parts. You can take felhound brains from mana eaters, mage hunters, or ley hunters. The wings come from nether maidens, sisters, or sorceresses, while doomwarder captains and lords carry the blood. Kreldig would understand if you passed on this one.

sections.title: Demons in Desolace
sections.body: Kreldig Ungor had not known these demons lived in Desolace. His reading said the centaur held most of the land after the night elves departed years ago. So he wonders how the demons came here and why they settled. They dwell near Mannoroc Coven in southern Desolace, beyond the Kodo Graveyard.

faq.q: Who is asking for these demon parts?
faq.answer: Kreldig Ungor passes along Leftwitch's list, and the demon parts are the final items she requested.

faq.q: What creatures hold the required items?
faq.answer: Mana eaters, mage hunters, and ley hunters have felhound brains. Nether maidens, sisters, and sorceresses have wings. Doomwarder captains and lords have blood.

faq.q: Where can these demons be found?
faq.answer: The demons gather near Mannoroc Coven in southern Desolace, beyond the Kodo Graveyard.

faq.q: Why does Kreldig find the demons surprising?
faq.answer: Kreldig had read that the centaur held Desolace after the night elves left years ago, so the demons' presence puzzles him.
